about: Music a film may use without asking: instrumental tracks dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0), each licence read on the track's own Free Music Archive page on the day given. tools/tracks.cjs fetches one into the project's music/ folder, checks it byte for byte against its sha256, measures it (tools/music.cjs) and writes its licence beside it. bpm and firstBar are as measured; drop is the bar (counted from firstBar) where the track lands hardest, build the bar its lead-in to the drop starts. A track the user brings always comes before these.

high-technologic-beat-explosion.title: High Technologic Beat Explosion
high-technologic-beat-explosion.confirmed: 2026-10-28, on the track's FMA page: CC0 1.0 Universal, marked Instrumental
high-technologic-beat-explosion.says: electro, a long build that climbs for 30 bars, then a hard four-on-the-floor drop

it-feels-good-to-be-alive-too.title: It feels good to be alive too
it-feels-good-to-be-alive-too.confirmed: 2026-10-28, on the track's FMA page: CC0 1.0 Universal, marked Instrumental
it-feels-good-to-be-alive-too.says: bright electro-pop, rising out of silence over seven bars, the drop on bar 8 (+6 dB)

everyone-is-so-alive.title: Everyone is so alive
everyone-is-so-alive.confirmed: 2026-10-28, on the track's FMA page: CC0 1.0 Universal, marked Instrumental
everyone-is-so-alive.says: fast, happy chiptune-pop; a three-bar break (bars 13-15) before the drop on bar 16

after-party.title: After Party
after-party.confirmed: 2026-10-28, on the track's FMA page: CC0 1.0 Universal, marked Instrumental
after-party.says: a mid-tempo groove, even and light; the band lifts on bar 63

i-need-you.title: I Need You
i-need-you.album: Be Happy With Who You Are
i-need-you.confirmed: 2026-10-28, on the track's FMA page: CC0 1.0 Universal, listed under lo-fi instrumental genres
i-need-you.says: warm lo-fi; rises from silence over bars 1-3, thins on bars 14-15, and the band opens up on bar 16 (+10 dB)
